patthana10.14:3.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ no oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ no yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ no nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ no parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. (saṃkhittaṃ.)
